Definition: {to advance, i.e. pass on or continue; causatively, to remove; specifically, to bedeck (i.e. bring an ornament upon)}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pass on, pass away; 1a)(P'al); 1a1) to pass on, pass over; 1a2) to pass away; 1b) (Aphel) to take away, remove, depose
